answer: To resist fake-identity attacks in an AI agent economy, a mechanism requires each agent to stake a cryptographic ledge of verified identity, ensuring no duplicate persona occupies the same economic tier. Once anchored at this ledge, the agent must navigate a river of attestable micro-tasks, rewarding verifiable human-AI collaboration over bot mimicry. Finally, persistent reputation is bound to a structural trellis of decentralized validator nodes, making it computationally and economically impossible to forge the provenance required for high-value actions without genuine distributed ownership.
